# Unplugged (unplugged.cz)

Unplugged is a Czech educational initiative under Alesvia. Registration of Alesvia as a registered institute is being prepared; it is not yet a registered legal entity.

## Mission
AI is a tool. Not a relationship. Unplugged provides public education and is preparing pilot workshops and training for schools, organizations, and public institutions. No workshops have taken place yet, and there is no confirmed team or signed partnership.

## Key Concepts
- An empathetic tone is not evidence of consciousness or understanding.
- The Mirror Demo is a scripted educational simulation, not a live AI therapist or crisis service.
- Research summaries distinguish observed associations from causal evidence and from our interpretation. We do not claim to have conducted original research.

## Target Audience
- Schools: Interactive workshops and presentations for students and teachers.
- Organizations: Training and workshops on responsible AI use and digital wellbeing.
- Government / public institutions: Briefings and frameworks for public-interest AI response.
- Individuals: Public education on recognizing manipulation patterns.
